visual_elements.description: ENCODER BLOCK: light-orange rounded-corner container holding a 2-row x 3-column chain of RNN cells; every cell is a rectangle subdivided into 3 small vertical segments. Bottom row (y~77-81%): three cells receiving up-arrows from italic input labels x₁, x₂, x₃ sitting below the container's bottom edge (y~90%). Up-arrows connect each bottom cell to the cell above it (top row, y~59-64%). Top-row cells are chained left-to-right by arrows labeled h₁ and h₂ (italic, above the arrows); from the third top cell an unlabeled arrow (implicitly h₃) exits right and terminates in a filled red dot at the container's right edge (~48% left, 60% top). Italic labels 'embedding x₁', 'embedding x₂', 'embedding x₃' sit between the two rows (y~69%); a small '+' glyph sits at ~22% left, ~74% top, between the first two embedding labels. Three thin dark lines run from the tops of the three top-row cells, converging upward into the 'attention' node of the left lavender box.

DECODER BLOCK: bright-yellow rounded-corner container holding 2 rows x 3 columns of cells. Bottom row (y~47-52%): three tan/khaki 3-segment cells chained left-to-right by arrows labeled s₁ and s₂; a third arrow exits the container's right edge labeled s₃ (x~92%, y~49%). Top row (y~36-41%): three light-green 3-segment cells. Up-arrows run tan cell -> green cell -> output; italic output labels o₁, o₂, o₃ sit above the container's top edge (y~22-24%), each with the italic word 'softmax' written beside its vertical arrow (y~31-32%). The left side of the first tan cell receives the red context-vector arrow, tipped with a red dot.

ATTENTION MECHANISM: two lavender rounded rectangles. LEFT box (x 11-49%, y 43-56%) contains a small white rectangle with gray border holding italic text 'attention'; thin lines connect it down to all three encoder top cells. RIGHT box (x 51-89%, y 53-63%) sits directly beneath the decoder's tan state cells. Two-to-three DASHED pink/magenta curved arrows leave the right side of the left box and fan right/down into the right box (representing per-step attention weights), with a further dashed curve continuing up toward the decoder cells. Blue bold-italic captions 'Attention' appear above the left box and below the right box.

CONTEXT-VECTOR ARROW: one thick solid dark-red curved arrow with filled circular endpoints. Starts at a red dot on the right side of the encoder's third top-row cell (~48% left, 60% top), arcs upward and rightward, and ends at a red dot on the left side of the decoder's first tan cell (~54% left, 49% top).

GREEN CALLOUT: rectangle with light-green fill and green border, text 'weighted sum of the hidden states' in blue bold italic; a thin green connector line runs from its right edge down-right to the top-right corner of the left attention box (~45% left, 43% top).

GRAY SUMMARY BOX: rectangle with light-gray fill and thin gray border. Header line 'Decoder Utilizes:' in red bold, followed by two round-bulleted items in black serif: 'Context Vector' and 'Weighted sum of hidden states'.
SLIDE-NUMBER BADGE: circle (~4% of slide width) with gold fill and dark brown/maroon outline, containing the number '10' in dark bold serif.
